name: 前程无忧 51Job
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=前程无忧 51Job
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = appapi.51job*.com, cupid.51job*.comhostname, =, img01.51jobcdn.com, cupid.51job*.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/appapi\.51job(app)?\.com\/api\/market\/(adtrace|get_launch|get_prompt)/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cupid\.51job(app)?\.com\/open\/index\/recommend-infos/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/img01\.51jobcdn\.com\/im\/mkt\/(?:tg\/((19|20)\d{2})banner\/(?!jcgz2\/)|\d{4}\/bd\/\d{4}\/).*\.jpg/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/appapi\.51job(app)?\.com\/api\/util\/get_version/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cupid\.51job(app)?\.com\/open\/noauth\/index\/last-version/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/appapi\.51job(app)?\.com\/api\/market\/(?>adtrace|get_launch|get_prompt)/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cupid\.51job(app)?\.com\/open\/guide\/home-page-top/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cupid\.51job(app)?\.com\/open\/user-task\/user\/task\/init/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cupid\.51job(app)?\.com\/open\/index\/notice-infos/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cupid\.51job(app)?\.com\/launch-hub\/open\/noauth\/popUp/i then reject(404)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cupid\.51job(app)?\.com\/open\/noauth\/recommend\/job-tab-dynamic/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/51job.js") with enable=${51job_enable}, tag="51job", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cupid\.51job(app)?\.com\/open\/noauth\/recommend\/job-tab-dynamic/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/51job.js") with enable=${51job_enable}, tag="去哒", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cupid\.51job(app)?\.com\/open\/my-page\//i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/51job.js") with enable=${51job_enable}, tag="去哒", timeout=60, requires_body=true
